name: @skein-js/example-deep-agent
description: A LangChain Deep Agent served by skein from an unchanged langgraph.json: planning, a synchronous subagent streamed under its own namespace, per-thread files, per-user durable memory, human approval of a sensitive tool, and an async subagent driven over the Agent Protocol. Runs offline with a scripted model, or against a real model via DEEP_AGENT_MODEL.
